result:
Created and validated. Workflow is in your personal project.

**What it does** (runs daily at 07:00):
1. **Every Morning 07:00** — Schedule Trigger.
2. **Fetch Exchange Emails (EWS)** — HTTP POST to your on-premise Exchange EWS endpoint (SOAP `FindItem`), filtered to messages received in the last 24h. Uses Basic Auth (standard for on-prem Exchange).
3. **Parse EWS XML → Normalize Emails** — turns the SOAP response into a clean text list of sender/subject/received/body.
4. **Extract & Prioritize Action Items** — AI Agent with an OpenAI Chat Model; extracts action items and ranks them High/Medium/Low, returning an HTML digest.
5. **Send Daily Digest** — Send Email (SMTP) delivers the structured digest.

**Key call:** you asked to swap Gmail for **Outlook/Exchange on-premise**. n8n's Microsoft Outlook node is cloud/Graph-only and won't reach an on-prem server, so I used **EWS over HTTP** (reading) + **SMTP** (sending) — the correct on-prem path.

**Before activating**, set these (all left as credentials/placeholders per your note):
- EWS endpoint URL + Basic Auth credential
- OpenAI credential
- SMTP credential + the from/to email addresses
